en: Sura 69: Al-Haqqah
ja: 第69章 真実章

p.src: 69:1  The Inevitable Hour!

en: The Inevitable Hour!
ja: 真実（である復活の日*）、
u.src: 69:1  The Inevitable Hour!

p.src: 69:2  What is the Inevitable Hour?

en: What is the Inevitable Hour?
ja: 真実（である復活の日*）とは何か？
u.src: 69:2  What is the Inevitable Hour?

p.src: 69:3  How do you know what the Inevitable Hour is?

en: How do you know what the Inevitable Hour is?
ja: （使徒*よ、）あなたに、真実（である復活の日*）が何かということを知らせるものは、何か？
u.src: 69:3  How do you know what the Inevitable Hour is?

p.src: 69:4  Thamūd and ‘Ād denied the Striking Calamity of the Hour[1].

en: Thamūd and ‘Ād denied the Striking Calamity of the Hour[1].
ja: サムード*とアード*は、（恐怖による）衝撃（である復活の日*）を噓呼ばわりした。
u.src: 69:4  Thamūd and ‘Ād denied the Striking Calamity of the Hour[1].

en: [1] The Striking Calamity is one of the names of the Day of Judgment.

p.src: 69:5  As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by a dreadful blast.

en: As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by a dreadful blast.
ja: それでサムード*はといえば、甚だしいものによって[1]滅ぼされた。
u.src: 69:5  As for Thamūd, they were destroyed by a dreadful blast.

ja: [1]　この「甚だしいものによって」には、「（轟きの）一声によって」「罪ゆえに」「雌ラクダを屠（ほふ）った者（高壁章７７とその訳注を参照）ゆえに」といった解釈がある（イブン・カスィール＊；2０８参照）。尚、サムード*に下された懲罰の詳細については、頻出名・用語解説の「サムード*」の項を参照。

p.src: 69:6  And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a furious windstorm[2]

ar: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
en: And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a furious windstorm[2]
ja: またアード*はといえば、凄まじい咆哮の暴風によって滅ぼされた。
u.src: 69:6  And as for ‘Ād, they were destroyed by a furious windstorm[2]

en: [2] Or by a cold windstorm.

p.src: 69:7  which He unleashed against them for seven successive nights and eight days, so you would see the people lying dead as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
en: which He unleashed against them for seven successive nights and eight days, so you would see the people lying dead as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
ja: かれ（アッラー*）はそれ（暴風）で彼らを、七晩と八昼に渡って続けざまに制圧した。あなたはその民がその（暴風の）中で、まるで空洞になったナツメヤシの木の根幹のようになぎ倒されているのを見る。
u.src: 69:7  which He unleashed against them for seven successive nights and eight days, so you would see the people lying dead as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

p.src: 69:8  Do you see any trace of them now?

en: Do you see any trace of them now?
ja: あなたは彼らの内、一人でも（その懲罰から生き）残った者を見出すのか？
u.src: 69:8  Do you see any trace of them now?

p.src: 69:9  Also, Pharaoh and those who came before him, and the overturned cities [of Lot] committed the grave sin,

ar: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
en: Also, Pharaoh and those who came before him, and the overturned cities [of Lot] committed the grave sin,
ja: また、フィルアウン*とそれ以前の（不信仰）者*、転覆した町々[1]は、罪[2]を犯した。
u.src: 69:9  Also, Pharaoh and those who came before him, and the overturned cities [of Lot] committed the grave sin,

ja: [1]　「転覆した町々」については、悔悟章７０の訳注を参照。それが滅ぼされた時の様子については、フード*章８2－８３、アル＝ヒジュル章７３－７４を参照。 [2]　この「罪」は、不信仰、シルク*、醜行などのこと（ムヤッサル５６７頁参照）。

p.src: 69:10  each disobeying the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a severe punishment.

ar: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
en: each disobeying the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a severe punishment.
ja: 彼らは自分たちの主*の使徒*に逆らった。それで、かれ（（アッラー*）は途轍もない罰で彼らを罰した。
u.src: 69:10  each disobeying the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a severe punishment.

p.src: 69:11  Indeed, when the floodwater overflowed, We carried you [O humans] in the sailing Ark[3],

ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
en: Indeed, when the floodwater overflowed, We carried you [O humans] in the sailing Ark[3],
ja: 本当にわれら*は、（洪水で）水が溢れた時、あなた方（の先祖であるヌーフ*と、彼と共にあった者たち）を、走るもの（船）に乗せて運んだ。[1]
u.src: 69:11  Indeed, when the floodwater overflowed, We carried you [O humans] in the sailing Ark[3],

en: [3] Which was made by Noah with Allah's command.
ja: [1]　この出来事の描写は、フード*章４０－４８に詳しい。

p.src: 69:12  so that We might make it a reminder for you, and that attentive ears may take heed.

ar: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
en: so that We might make it a reminder for you, and that attentive ears may take heed.
ja: （それは、）われら*がそれ[1]をあなた方への教訓とし、分別ある耳がそれを分別（し、記憶）するためである。
u.src: 69:12  so that We might make it a reminder for you, and that attentive ears may take heed.

ja: [1]　「それ」とは、信仰者が救われ、不信仰者*は溺（おぼ）れ死んだという、その出来事のことを指す（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 69:13  Then when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast,

ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
en: Then when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast,
ja: 角笛に一吹き、吹き込まれ、[1]
u.src: 69:13  Then when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast,

ja: [1]　これは、一回目の吹き込みのこと（前掲書、同頁参照）。家畜章７３の訳注も参照。

p.src: 69:14  and the earth and mountains are lifted up and crushed with a single blow,

ar: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
en: and the earth and mountains are lifted up and crushed with a single blow,
ja: 大地と山々が（元の場所から）運ばれ、それらが一撃のもと粉々にされる時、[1]
u.src: 69:14  and the earth and mountains are lifted up and crushed with a single blow,

ja: [1]　復活の日*の天変地異の様子については洞窟章４７、ター・ハー章1０５－1０７、蟻章８８、山章９－1０、出来事章５－６、衣を纏（まと）う 者章1４、階段章８－９、消息章2０、巻き込む章３、衝撃章４－５なども参照。

p.src: 69:15  on that Day the Inevitable Event will occur.

en: on that Day the Inevitable Event will occur.
ja: その日、（復活の日*という）出来事は起こる。
u.src: 69:15  on that Day the Inevitable Event will occur.

p.src: 69:16  And the sky will split asunder and will be frail[4] on that day,

en: And the sky will split asunder and will be frail[4] on that day,
ja: また天は裂け、それはその日脆くなる。
u.src: 69:16  And the sky will split asunder and will be frail[4] on that day,

en: [4] i.e., weak and unstable.

p.src: 69:17  with the angels on all its sides, and on that Day, eight [mighty angels] will bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

ar: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
en: with the angels on all its sides, and on that Day, eight [mighty angels] will bear the Throne of your Lord above them.
ja: そして天使*は（天の）その方々にあり、八名（の天使*）がその日、あなたの主*の御座[1]をその上に担ぐ。[2]
u.src: 69:17  with the angels on all its sides, and on that Day, eight [mighty angels] will bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

ja: [1]　「御座」については、高壁章５４の訳注を参照。 [2]　同様の状況を示すアーヤ*として、雌牛章21０とその訳注、識別章2５、暁章22も参照。

p.src: 69:18  On that day, you will be brought forth [before Allah], and none of your secrets will remain hidden.

ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
en: On that day, you will be brought forth [before Allah], and none of your secrets will remain hidden.
ja: （人々よ、）その日、あなた方は（清算と報いへと）差し出されるのだ。あなた方のいかなる秘め事も、（アッラー*から）隠しおおせはしない。
u.src: 69:18  On that day, you will be brought forth [before Allah], and none of your secrets will remain hidden.

p.src: 69:19  As for the one who is given his Record in his right hand, he will say, “Here is my Record, read it!

ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
en: As for the one who is given his Record in his right hand, he will say, “Here is my Record, read it!
ja: 自分の（行いの）帳簿を右手に渡された者はといえば、（嬉々として、こう）言う。「お取り下さい、我が帳簿をお読み下さい。[1]
u.src: 69:19  As for the one who is given his Record in his right hand, he will say, “Here is my Record, read it!

ja: [1]　高壁章８の訳注も参照。また、この時の様子については夜の旅章1３－1４、７1とその訳注、洞窟章４９、割れる章７以降なども参照。

p.src: 69:20  I was sure that I would meet my reckoning.”

en: I was sure that I would meet my reckoning.”
ja: 私は、我が清算と面会することを、（現世で）確信していたのですから」。
u.src: 69:20  I was sure that I would meet my reckoning.”

p.src: 69:21  So he will be in a pleasant life,

en: So he will be in a pleasant life,
ja: 彼は、満足する生活の中にある、
u.src: 69:21  So he will be in a pleasant life,

p.src: 69:22  in a lofty garden,

en: in a lofty garden,
ja: 高き楽園の中。
u.src: 69:22  in a lofty garden,

p.src: 69:23  with clustered fruit within his reach.

en: with clustered fruit within his reach.
ja: その果実の房は、手近にある。
u.src: 69:23  with clustered fruit within his reach.

p.src: 69:24  [They will be told,] “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did[5] in the days gone by.”

ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
en: [They will be told,] “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did[5] in the days gone by.”
ja: （彼らには、こう言われる。）「過ぎ去った（現世での）日々において、あなた方が既に行った（正しい）ことゆえ、おいしく食べ、飲むがよい」。
u.src: 69:24  [They will be told,] “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did[5] in the days gone by.”

en: [5] Lit., "advanced" anticipating the reward in the Hereafter.

p.src: 69:25  As for the one who is given his Record in his left hand, he will say, “Would that I had not been given my Record,

ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
en: As for the one who is given his Record in his left hand, he will say, “Would that I had not been given my Record,
ja: そして、自分の（行いの）帳簿を左手に渡された者[1]はといえば、（悔しがって、こう）言う。「我が帳簿など渡されることがなかったら、よかったのに。
u.src: 69:25  As for the one who is given his Record in his left hand, he will say, “Would that I had not been given my Record,

ja: [1]　割れる章1０と、その訳注も参照。

p.src: 69:26  nor had I known anything of my reckoning!

en: nor had I known anything of my reckoning!
ja: 我が清算など、知らなければよかった。
u.src: 69:26  nor had I known anything of my reckoning!

p.src: 69:27  Would that it [i.e., death] had been the end of me[6]!

en: Would that it [i.e., death] had been the end of me[6]!
ja: あれが終結であれば、よかったのに。[1]
u.src: 69:27  Would that it [i.e., death] had been the end of me[6]!

en: [6] Rather than a gateway to eternal life.
ja: [1]　つまり復活などなく、現世での死で全てが終わっていればよかったのに、ということ（ムヤッサル５６７頁参照）。

p.src: 69:28  My wealth has been of no avail to me.

en: My wealth has been of no avail to me.
ja: 我が財産は、私の役に立たなかった。
u.src: 69:28  My wealth has been of no avail to me.

p.src: 69:29  My authority has vanished[7].”

en: My authority has vanished[7].”
ja: （言い訳に出来る）我が根拠[1]は、私から消え失せてしまったのだ」。
u.src: 69:29  My authority has vanished[7].”

en: [7] i.e., I have no valid argument or authority today.
ja: [1]　「根拠」ではなく、「王権、力」といった少数派の見解もある（アル＝バガウィー５：1４８参照）。

p.src: 69:30  [It will be said,] “Seize him and shackle him,

en: [It will be said,] “Seize him and shackle him,
ja: （地獄の番人たちに、こう言われる。）「彼を捕まえ、（枷で）縛りつけよ。
u.src: 69:30  [It will be said,] “Seize him and shackle him,

p.src: 69:31  then make him burn in the Blazing Fire,

en: then make him burn in the Blazing Fire,
ja: それから彼を地獄に入れて、炙ってやれ。
u.src: 69:31  then make him burn in the Blazing Fire,

p.src: 69:32  then tie him up with a chain of seventy cubits long.

ar: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
en: then tie him up with a chain of seventy cubits long.
ja: それから、七十腕尺[1]の長さの鎖の中に、彼を巻き入れよ。
u.src: 69:32  then tie him up with a chain of seventy cubits long.

ja: [1]　アル＝ハサン*は言った。「それがいかなる（基準による）腕尺かは、アッラー*が最もよくご存知である」（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 69:33  For he did not believe in Allah, the Most Great,

ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
en: For he did not believe in Allah, the Most Great,
ja: 本当に彼は、この上なく偉大な*アッラー*を信じておらず、
u.src: 69:33  For he did not believe in Allah, the Most Great,

p.src: 69:34  nor did he encourage feeding the needy.

en: nor did he encourage feeding the needy.
ja: 貧者*たちに食べ物を施すことを、勧めてもいなかったのだから。
u.src: 69:34  nor did he encourage feeding the needy.

p.src: 69:35  So Today he will have no close friend here,

en: So Today he will have no close friend here,
ja: ゆえにこの日、彼にはそこで（懲罰から守ってくれる）、近しい者もいなければ、
u.src: 69:35  So Today he will have no close friend here,

p.src: 69:36  nor any food except the discharge of wounds,

en: nor any food except the discharge of wounds,
ja: （地獄の徒の体から出る）膿[1]ぐらいしか、食べ物もない。
u.src: 69:36  nor any food except the discharge of wounds,

ja: [1]　この「膿（ギスリーン）」には、「地獄の徒が食べる木」「地獄の徒の血肉」「ザックームの木（夜の旅章６０「呪われた木」の訳注を参照）」といった解釈もある（アル＝クルトゥビー1８：2７３参照）。

p.src: 69:37  none will eat it except the sinners.”

en: none will eat it except the sinners.”
ja: それを食べるのは、（不信仰による）罪深い者たちのみである」。
u.src: 69:37  none will eat it except the sinners.”

p.src: 69:38  I swear by what you can see.

en: I swear by what you can see.
ja: われはまさに、あなた方が見えるものにおいて、誓う。[1]
u.src: 69:38  I swear by what you can see.

ja: [1]　この誓いについては、整列者章1の訳注を参照。

p.src: 69:39  and what you cannot see!

en: and what you cannot see!
ja: また、あなた方が見えないものにおいて（、誓う）。
u.src: 69:39  and what you cannot see!

p.src: 69:40  Indeed, this is the word of a noble Messenger[8],

en: Indeed, this is the word of a noble Messenger[8],
ja: 本当にそれ（クルアーン*）は、まさしく高貴なる使徒*の（読誦する、アッラー*の）言葉。
u.src: 69:40  Indeed, this is the word of a noble Messenger[8],

en: [8] i.e., recited by Prophet Muhammad (ﷺ).

p.src: 69:41  and it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe!

ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
en: and it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe!
ja: そしてそれは、詩人の言葉などではない。あなた方が信じることの、少ないことよ。
u.src: 69:41  and it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe!

p.src: 69:42  Nor is it the word of a soothsayer; little do you take heed!

ar: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
en: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer; little do you take heed!
ja: また、占い師[1]の言葉でもない。あなた方が教訓を受けることの、少ないことよ。
u.src: 69:42  Nor is it the word of a soothsayer; little do you take heed!

ja: [1]　「占い師」については、山章2９の訳注を参照。

p.src: 69:43  It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

en: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
ja: （クルアーン*は）全創造物の主*アッラー*からの、降示なのである。
u.src: 69:43  It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

p.src: 69:44  If he had falsely attributed something to Us,

en: If he had falsely attributed something to Us,
ja: もし、彼（ムハンマド*）がわれら*に対し、いくらかでも（われら*が言っていない）言葉を捏造したのであれば、
u.src: 69:44  If he had falsely attributed something to Us,

p.src: 69:45  We would have surely seized him by the right hand[9],

en: We would have surely seized him by the right hand[9],
ja: われら*は彼を右手[1]で罰し、
u.src: 69:45  We would have surely seized him by the right hand[9],

en: [9] Or "by [Our] Right Hand," i.e., Allah would have surely exacted revenge with might and power.
ja: [1]　この「右手」とは、力強さのことを表す（ムヤッサル５６８頁参照）。

p.src: 69:46  then severed his aorta[10],

en: then severed his aorta[10],
ja: それから、彼の大動脈を断ち切ってしまっただろう。[1]
u.src: 69:46  then severed his aorta[10],

en: [10] i.e., his life artery of the heart; causing immediate death.
ja: [1]　同様のアーヤ*として、相談章2４とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 69:47  and none of you could have rescued him.

ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
en: and none of you could have rescued him.
ja: そして、あなた方の内の誰も、彼を（われら*の懲罰から）遮る者はないのである。
u.src: 69:47  and none of you could have rescued him.

p.src: 69:48  This [Qur’an] is indeed a reminder for those who are righteous.

en: This [Qur’an] is indeed a reminder for those who are righteous.
ja: また、本当にそれ（クルアーン*）は、敬虔*な者たちへの教訓である。
u.src: 69:48  This [Qur’an] is indeed a reminder for those who are righteous.

p.src: 69:49  And We surely know that some of you will be deniers,

en: And We surely know that some of you will be deniers,
ja: そして実にわれら*は、あなた方の内に（それを）噓呼ばわりする者たちがいることを、まさしく知っている。
u.src: 69:49  And We surely know that some of you will be deniers,

p.src: 69:50  and it[11] will certainly be a source of regret for the disbelievers.

en: and it[11] will certainly be a source of regret for the disbelievers.
ja: また、本当にそれは、まさに不信仰者*たちへの悲痛[1]である。
u.src: 69:50  and it[11] will certainly be a source of regret for the disbelievers.

en: [11] i.e., denying this Qur’an.
ja: [1]　不信仰者*たちは、自分たちがクルアーン*によって約束されていたもの（罰）を目にする時、それによって導かれず、それに従いもしなかったことゆえに褒美（ほうび）を貰い損ね、現世に戻る機会も失ったことを知り、「悲痛」の念にとらわれる（アッ＝サアディー８８４頁参照）。

p.src: 69:51  And this[12] is indeed the absolute truth.

en: And this[12] is indeed the absolute truth.
ja: そして本当にそれは、確固たる真実なのだ。
u.src: 69:51  And this[12] is indeed the absolute truth.

en: [12] i.e., this Qur’an.

p.src: 69:52  So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

en: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
ja: ならばこの上なく偉大な*、あなたの主*の御名で（アッラー*を）称え*よ。[1]
u.src: 69:52  So glorify the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

ja: [1]　アッラー*を唱念し、人々をかれとその教えへと招き続けよ、あなたと信仰者たちにこそ、よき結末が待っているのだ、という意味（アル＝カースィミー1６：５９22参照）。
